_README: Flip tag settings for score.py. Edit the numbers below and rerun ./scripts/run_all.sh; nothing else needs to change.
A flip = the same creator switching a ticker from bullish to bearish (or back).
pending           - fewer than forward_sessions sessions of price data after the flip yet.
ahead             - over the forward_sessions sessions after the flip (next session's open -> close of the Nth session),
the stock moved in the NEW direction by more than ahead_min_move.
after             - not 'ahead', AND over the prior_sessions sessions before the flip the stock had already moved
in the new direction by more than prior_min_move (the creator flipped after the move, no follow-through).
no_follow_through - neither: the stock did not move the new way afterwards and had not moved that way before.
Moves are decimals: 0.01 = 1%. Working definition from Manager Bot; Naman has NOT confirmed it yet.
_forward_sessions: Sessions after the flip used for 'ahead'. 5 matches the 5D column.
_prior_sessions: Sessions before the flip (ending on the last close on or before the video date) used for 'after'.
_ahead_min_move: Minimum move in the new direction after the flip to call it 'ahead'. 0.0 = any move the new way.
_prior_min_move: Minimum move in the new direction before the flip to call it 'after'. 0.0 = any move the new way.
_vs_spy: true = judge both windows on the move minus SPY's move over the same dates (removes the market's move).
